code:
Total Sales = SUM ( Fact[LineTotal] )
Order Count = DISTINCTCOUNT ( Fact[SalesOrderID] )
Average Order Value = DIVIDE ( [Total Sales], [Order Count] )
caption: DIVIDE returns blank instead of erroring on a zero-order slice.

code:
Total Sales (All Segments) =
CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], ALL ( DimCustomer ) )

Pct of Company Total (Segment) =
DIVIDE ( [Total Sales], [Total Sales (All Segments)] )
caption: ALL(DimCustomer) strips the segment filter for a company-wide denominator.

code:
Total Sales (All Territories) =
CALCULATE ( [Total Sales], ALL ( DimTerritory ) )

Pct of Company Total (Territory) =
DIVIDE ( [Total Sales], [Total Sales (All Territories)] )
caption: Same mechanism, applied to the territory dimension instead.

subtitle: Three similarly-named measures are about to matter.
